editorial:
Imagine finding a weird spider and deciding to keep it as a pet. That is exactly what 12-year-old Charlotte does, but this is no ordinary bug. It is way too smart and starts acting in ways that feel almost human. You get to see her bond with the creature in secret, which starts off cute but quickly turns into a nightmare. The vibe is a mix of a coming-of-age story and a creepy creature feature that makes you want to check every corner of your room for webs. It feels like a classic monster movie but with a modern twist on how kids handle secrets.

The acting is great, especially the lead girl who really sells the fear and guilt. The pacing keeps you on your toes, though some parts move a bit slow before the chaos hits. If you love movies where pets turn evil, you will have a blast.
endingExplained: Everything goes south when the spider grows huge and starts hunting the family. In the final showdown, Charlotte realizes her pet is a monster that cannot be tamed. She has to stop being a kid and fight back to save her parents. After a scary battle in the house, she manages to kill the creature. The movie ends with her safe, but you are left wondering if every single egg was actually destroyed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves creature features and scary spiders.
